title.en: Insightful coaching by Yuri and Angela

text.en: Clients praise Yuri and Angela for their deep understanding of animal psychology and calm, encouraging guidance. Owners appreciate that the trainers break down complex exercises into manageable steps and patiently teach families how to handle behaviors.

Reviews frequently cite significant behavioral progress, especially with leash pulling, barking, and reactivity toward strangers or other dogs. Clients note lasting improvements in impulse control and daily obedience following structured home routines.

Dog parents appreciate the positive reinforcement methodology that builds confidence in young puppies and anxious rescues without intimidation. Reviewers mention that dogs eagerly greet the trainers and look forward to participating in weekly lessons.

q.en: Do they assist with reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients report noticeable progress in managing reactivity toward dogs and strangers on city walks.
Reviewers emphasize that trainers use positive reinforcement techniques focused on animal behavior and mutual trust.

q.en: Can they help with puppy foundational skills?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviews highlight success with early puppy socialization, potty training, and basic house manners.
